title: Cyrus and the Deadline
author: K. M. Dravenmoor
blurb: Coral Dravenmoor, a whistle-blower living under four names, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
